note: Reel 27: You're the Guard. Episode 5 of 'You're the test subject'. The narrator is the series voice (af_heart), talking to you, the guard. The four men (a01, b01, c01, d01) are four different male voices, cast in the voice lab. Read audio/vo_lab/takes/phonemes.md after every run.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.

lines.text: You're the guard at this gate, and whoever you point at tonight goes to jail.
Ask this delivery man his name.
Does the label match your book?
Then who robbed flat three zero two?
Police have four men in that jacket.
Point at yours, and he goes to jail.
Which one? You looked right at him.
You're right. He was at your gate.
Every time you looked down, one walked in, and the next stepped up.
So you've just sent one to jail, and three of them home.
You checked his name, his flat, his parcel, but you never checked his face.
Psychologists did this to real people in 1998.
One woman who missed it said she'd just seen a construction worker.
So who brought your last parcel?
